task: Process 2 bounded asynchronous Vulkan submissions for the captured retail Bink draw

retail_capture.scope: Offscreen replay of one captured Bink draw using retail translated vertex, geometry, pixel, and Copy/Convert shaders, captured shader constants, three R8 planes, and harness full-screen rectangle vertices. Does not replay guest decode or the full mixed-sample frame.

implementation.synchronization: Per-frame VkFence; cached no-readback calls return after submission. Fence-signaled resources are reclaimed on later calls. Reusing an upload slot waits only for frames using that slot; reaching the in-flight bound waits for the oldest frame.

device_microbenchmark.measurement_limit: CPU-side renderer-call elapsed time including bounded fence backpressure; not GPU-only time, full-game FPS, or end-to-end Bink playback rate.

host_regression.renderer_regression: Submits four cached asynchronous frames, follows with synchronous readback, and checks output equality with the prior captured test frame.
host_regression.vulkan_validation: Enabled for native renderer CTest; zero validation errors reported.

android_arm64_plugin.provider_sdk_depth_stencil_resolve_capab: Not present in the v0.10.0 Android provider snapshot.

limitations: Single captured draw replay; no claim of full cutscene or game parity.
